meta.title: Compline Lessons
meta.description: Short weekly cycle of bedtime lessons for Compline, drawn from classic 1928 BCP options and traditional night-prayer texts (comfort, watchfulness, rest in Christ). Suitable for 1662/1928/REC use.
notes: These are intentionally brief — one or two short passages per night.
Classic fixed options from 1928 BCP Compline include Jeremiah 14:9, Matthew 11:28–30, and Hebrews 13:20–21.
A simple fixed alternative is to use Matthew 11:28–30 every night.
